intro.title: Hi, I’m {name}
intro.line: Hi, I’m {name}, your guide to Talaan. Talaan runs payroll and government compliance for every client your firm looks after. In three minutes I’ll show you how.

home.title: Your home screen
home.line: Every client on one screen. Green means on track, yellow means a deadline is near, and red means something needs you today. Search finds any client, employee or pay run.

payrun.title: Run payroll in five steps
payrun.line: Pick the client and the cutoff, and bring in the hours. Talaan fills in the rest: allowances from each pay template, loan deductions, and approved leave without pay.

checks.title: Talaan catches mistakes for you
checks.line: Before anything is paid, Talaan checks every employee. Red stops you until it’s fixed. Yellow asks for a short reason. Each message tells you how to fix it.

approve.title: Two people, one approval
approve.line: The person who prepares payroll can’t approve it. The business owner gets a simple summary on their phone and taps Approve. After that, the pay run is locked.

files.title: Every file, every deadline
files.line: Talaan prepares the SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and BIR files, and the bank file. The deadline calendar shows every client’s due dates in one month, and each payment is saved with its receipt.

extra.title: 13th month, bonuses and final pay
extra.line: Run the 13th month, a bonus or reimbursements as a separate pay run, and Talaan applies the ₱90,000 tax-free limit. When someone leaves, final pay works out the last salary, unused leave and the tax for the year.

people.title: Leave and payslips on any phone
people.line: Employees request leave and open their payslips and BIR Form 2316 on their phone. You approve leave in one tap, and every salary change is recorded with who made it and why.

byo.title: Works with other payroll systems
byo.line: Clients who keep another payroll system can still use Talaan. Upload their payroll register, and Talaan checks the contributions and tax, then prepares the government files.

books.title: Your books stay in step
books.line: Approved payroll goes to the client’s books as a balanced journal, mapped to their accounts and split by department. Send it to Xero, or download it for any accounting app.

analytics.title: See every client at a glance
analytics.line: Dashboards show payroll cost, government payments and on-time filing across all your clients. Every report downloads to Excel.

ask.title: Ask Tala, get the source
ask.line: Not sure about a rule? Ask me. I answer from official issuances and show you the source. If I can’t find one, I say so and pass it to your adviser.

ready.title: Ready when you are
ready.line: That’s Talaan: every payslip right and every deadline met, in English, Tagalog or Chinese. Let’s run your first payroll.
